ADAPTIVE HABIT LEAGUE — UI

Nine artboards in the Progression direction. Every screen has a dark / light switch above it.

The data is consistent across all of them: Thursday 20 August, week 8, level 4 (Focused), Study AI and Coding ticked in Google, German mid-timer at 27 of 45 minutes.

CALENDAR

Block heights are proportional to each habit's duration target — the view Google Calendar could not have given us, because a Google Task carries no time of day and no duration.

The app owns both, which is why the week grid can position and size a block at all.

SYNC STATUS

The status is a control, not a label: it states the connection, when it last ran and when it runs next, and opens the details panel on click.

Four states map to real conditions in the sync service — connected, syncing, offline with queued changes, and needs_reauth, which is the 7-day token expiry the Testing consent screen causes.

PHASE 3 PLACEHOLDERS

Leaderboard and Challenges stay in the sidebar so the navigation matches the finished product, but they state plainly that they are not built yet and why — rather than showing invented friends and fake scores.
